observations: The current limiting dependency is zero independent evaluation throughput, so a concrete handoff manifest has higher gate relevance than another retention-count variation.
Binding the handoff to a prior exact source commit avoids a self-referential artifact digest when handoff records are committed afterward.

result.evaluation_boundary: PASS only if every digest and binding validates, the request is unique, the ledger remains fail-closed with agi_claim_supported=false, and exact-head CI succeeds. Internal success remains readiness scaffolding, not AGI evidence.
